title: Extension of compatible ring actions from affine opens
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $R$ a sheaf of rings and $F$ a sheaf of abelian groups on its space. For each affine open $U$ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-opens-basis] give a unital ring map $\tau_U:R(U)\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathbf Z}(F(U))$. Assume that for every inclusion $i:V\subseteq U$ of affine opens, $\tau_U(r)(x)|_V=\tau_V(r|_V)(x|_V)$. Then there is a unique family of unital ring maps $\sigma_U:R(U)\to\operatorname{End}_{\mathbf Z}(F(U))$, now indexed by all opens, natural for all inclusions in the same sense, with $\sigma_U=\tau_U$ on each affine open. No quasi-coherence, intersection-closed affine basis, or finite-cover hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Tag 009O, label lemma-restrict-basis-equivalence, https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/009O read 2026-10-13; explicit application to the action map R times F to F in the affine-basis gluing of Tags 01LX and 0897.

proof.text: Form the presheaf of sets P(U)=R(U) times F(U). The action maps on the affine basis form a natural transformation into the underlying sheaf of sets of F. Use TopCat.Sheaf.restrictHomEquivHom and extend_hom_app to construct the unique extension alpha on all opens, with exactly the given affine components.

For a(U,r,x)=alpha_U(r,x), naturality and affine agreement say its restriction on every affine V contained in U is tau_V(r|V)(x|V). Separatedness of F and the affine basis prove zero and additivity in x, and zero, addition, unit, and multiplication in r from the corresponding local ring identities. Bundle these equations into a ring hom sigma_U. Naturality of alpha gives the naturality of sigma. Any other sigma restricts to the same local actions and hence equals it by separatedness.

lean.statement:
theorem affineBasis_ringAction_gluing
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (R : TopCat.Sheaf RingCat.{u} X)
    (F : TopCat.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{u} X)
    (tau : ∀ U : X.affineOpens,
      R.obj.obj (op U.val) →+* AddMonoid.End (F.obj.obj (op U.val)))
    (htau : ∀ (U V : X.affineOpens) (i : U.val ⟶ V.val)
      (r : R.obj.obj (op V.val)) (x : F.obj.obj (op V.val)),
      F.obj.map i.op (tau V r x) =
        tau U (R.obj.map i.op r) (F.obj.map i.op x)) :
    ∃! sigma : ∀ U : X.Opens,
      R.obj.obj (op U) →+* AddMonoid.End (F.obj.obj (op U)),
      (∀ (U V : X.Opens) (i : U ⟶ V)
        (r : R.obj.obj (op V)) (x : F.obj.obj (op V)),
        F.obj.map i.op (sigma V r x) =
          sigma U (R.obj.map i.op r) (F.obj.map i.op x)) ∧
      (∀ U : X.affineOpens, sigma U.val = tau U)
